     6|module
     7|
     8|public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Irreducible.Indecomposable
     9|public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Submodule.Union
    10|public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.OrzechProperty
    11|public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.QuadraticForm.Dual
    12|public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.RootSystem.Base
    13|
    14|/-!
    15|# Existence of bases for crystallographic root systems
    16|
    17|## Implementation details
    18|
    19|The proof needs a set of ordered coefficients, even though the existence ultimate statement does
    20|not. There are at least two ways to deal with this:
    21| (a) Using the fact that a crystallographic root system induces a `ℚ`-structure, pass to the root
    22|     system over `ℚ` defined by `RootPairing.restrictScalarsRat`, and develop a theory of base
    23|     change for root system bases.
    24| (b) Introduce a second set of ordered coefficients (ultimately taken to be `ℚ`) and develop a
    25|     theory with two sets of coefficients simultaneously in play.
    26|
    27|It is not really clear which is the better approach but here we opt for approach (b) as it seems
    28|to yield slightly more general results.
    29|
    30|## TODO
    31|
    32|1. Prove that for crystallographic reduced root systems, the axiom `coroot_mem_or_neg_mem` appearing
    33|   in `RootPairing.Base` follows from the others, and combine this with
    34|   `RootPairing.linearIndepOn_coroot_iff` to thus provide an alternate constructor for
    35|   `RootPairing.Base` which demands only the hypotheses on the roots.
    36|2. [Easy given 1 above] Prove that every reduced crystallographic root system has a base by
    37|   combining the constructor in 1 above with `RootPairing.linearIndepOn_root_baseOf`,
    38|   `IsAddIndecomposable.mem_or_neg_mem_closure_baseOf`, `Module.exists_dual_forall_apply_ne_zero`.
    39|
    40|-/
    41|
    42|@[expose] public section
    43|
    44|open Function IsAddIndecomposable Module Set Submodule
    45|
    46|namespace RootPairing
    47|
    48|variable {ι R M N : Type*} [Finite ι] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    49|
    50|section CommRing
    51|
    52|variable [CommRing R] [Module R M] [Module R N] (P : RootPairing ι R M N)
    53|  {S : Type*} [LinearOrder S] [AddCommGroup S] [IsOrderedAddMonoid S] (f : M →+ S)
    54|
    55|/-- This is [serre1965](Ch. V, §9, Lemma 3). -/
    56|lemma baseOf_pairwise_pairing_le_zero [CharZero R] [IsDomain R] [P.IsCrystallographic]
    57|    (hf : ∀ i, f (P.root i) ≠ 0) :
    58|    (baseOf P.root f).Pairwise fun i j ↦ P.pairingIn ℤ i j ≤ 0 := by
    59|  letI _i := P.indexNeg
    60|  intro i hi j hj hne
    61|  have := IsAddIndecomposable.pairwise_baseOf_sub_notMem P.root (by simp) f hf hi hj hne
    62|  contrapose! this
    63|  exact P.root_sub_root_mem_of_pairingIn_pos this hne
    64|
    65|/-- This lemma is usually established for root systems with coefficients `R` equal to `ℚ` or `ℝ`, in
    66|which case one may take `S = R`. However our statement allows for more general coefficients such as
    67|`R = ℂ` and `S = ℚ`.
    68|
    69|This lemma is mostly a stepping stone en route to `RootPairing.linearIndepOn_root_baseOf` (where
    70|linear independence is established over `R` rather than just `S`) except that this version does not
    71|make the field assumption and so covers the case `S = R = ℤ` which the latter does not. -/
    72|lemma linearIndepOn_root_baseOf' [IsDomain R] {S : Type*}
    73|    [LinearOrder S] [CommRing S] [IsStrictOrderedRing S] [Algebra S R] [FaithfulSMul S R]
    74|    [Module S M] [IsScalarTower S R M] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower S R N]
    75|    [P.IsValuedIn S] [P.IsCrystallographic]
    76|    (f : Dual S M) (hf : ∀ i, f (P.root i) ≠ 0) :
    77|    LinearIndepOn S P.root (baseOf P.root (f : M →+ S)) := by
    78|  have : CharZero R := Algebra.charZero_of_charZero S R
    79|  have : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
    80|  let M₀ := span S (range P.root)
    81|  let v (i : baseOf P.root (f : M →+ S)) : M₀ := P.rootSpanMem S i
    82|  change LinearIndependent S (M₀.subtype ∘ v)
    83|  suffices LinearIndependent S v by
    84|    rwa [LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_disjoint M₀.subtype (by simp)]
    85|  let f' : Dual S M₀ := f ∘ₗ M₀.subtype
    86|  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : P.RootPositiveForm S, B.posForm.toQuadraticMap.PosDef :=
    87|    ⟨P.posRootForm S, by simpa using P.posRootForm_rootFormIn_posDef S⟩
    88|  have hp (i : baseOf P.root (f : M →+ S)) : 0 < f' (v i) := by obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := i; simpa
    89|  have hn : Pairwise fun (i j : baseOf P.root (f : M →+ S)) ↦ B.posForm (v i) (v j) ≤ 0 := by
    90|    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ hij
    91|    rw [B.posForm_apply_root_root_le_zero_iff, ← P.algebraMap_pairingIn' S ℤ]
    92|    simpa using P.baseOf_pairwise_pairing_le_zero _ hf (by simpa) (by simpa) (by aesop : i ≠ j)
    93|  exact LinearMap.BilinForm.linearIndependent_of_pairwise_le_zero B.posForm hB f' v hp hn
    94|
    95|end CommRing
    96|
    97|section Field
    98|
    99|variable [Field R] [CharZero R] [Module R M] [Module R N] (P : RootPairing ι R M N)
   100|  [P.IsRootSystem] [P.IsCrystallographic]
   101|
   102|lemma linearIndepOn_root_baseOf [Module ℚ M] [Module ℚ N]
   103|    (f : Dual ℚ M) (hf : ∀ i, f (P.root i) ≠ 0) :
   104|    LinearIndepOn R P.root (baseOf P.root (f : M →+ ℚ)) := by
   105|  letI := P.indexNeg
   106|  have : Fintype (baseOf P.root (f : M →+ ℚ)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
   107|  let v (i : baseOf P.root (f : M →+ ℚ)) : P.rootSpan ℚ := P.rootSpanMem ℚ i
   108|  change LinearIndependent R ((P.rootSpan ℚ).subtype ∘ v)
   109|  have h_span : span ℚ (range v) = ⊤ := by
   110|    suffices span ℚ (range v) = span ℚ (range (P.rootSpanMem ℚ)) by
   111|      rw [this, eq_top_iff, ← LinearMap.map_le_map_iff' (f := (P.rootSpan ℚ).subtype) (by simp),
   112|        map_span, ← image_univ, ← image_comp]
   113|      simp
   114|    apply le_antisymm (span_mono fun x i ↦ by aesop) (span_le.mpr ?_)
   115|    rintro - ⟨i, rfl⟩
   116|    suffices (P.rootSpanMem ℚ i : M) ∈ span ℚ (P.root '' baseOf P.root (f : M →+ ℚ)) by
   117|      rw [← (injective_subtype (P.rootSpan ℚ)).mem_set_image, ← map_coe, SetLike.mem_coe, map_span,
   118|        ← image_univ, ← image_comp]
   119|      convert this
   120|      aesop
   121|    rw [← span_span_of_tower ℤ, ← Submodule.coe_toAddSubgroup, span_int_eq_addSubgroupClosure,
   122|      AddSubgroup.closure_image_isAddIndecomposable_baseOf P.root (by simp) (f : M →+ ℚ) (by simpa)]
   123|    exact subset_span <| AddSubgroup.subset_closure <| by simp
   124|  have h_card : Nat.card (baseOf P.root (f : M →+ ℚ)) = finrank R M := by
   125|    let b : Basis (baseOf P.root (f : M →+ ℚ)) ℚ (P.rootSpan ℚ) := by
   126|      replace this : LinearIndependent ℚ v :=
   127|        .of_comp (P.rootSpan ℚ).subtype <| P.linearIndepOn_root_baseOf' f hf
   128|      exact Basis.mk this (by rw [h_span])
   129|    rw [← RootPairing.finrank_rootSpanIn ℚ P, finrank_eq_nat_card_basis b]
   130|  have hv : span R (range <| (P.rootSpan ℚ).subtype ∘ v) = ⊤ := by
   131|    rw [range_comp, ← span_span_of_tower ℚ, span_image, h_span]
   132|    simp
   133|  rw [linearIndependent_iff_card_eq_finrank_span, Set.finrank, hv, finrank_top, ← h_card,
   134|    Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
   135|
   136|end Field
   137|
   138|end RootPairing
